# Shipping (Brightwater Cycles, made-up sample data)

## Delivery times
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days inside the country. Express delivery takes 1 business day
and costs 15 EUR extra. Orders placed after 2 pm ship the next business day.

## International orders
We ship to 12 countries in Europe. Delivery takes 7 to 10 business days. The customer pays import duties.
We do not ship to Switzerland or Norway.
